title: God in the Completions: The Inversion of the God-of-the-Gaps Argument

canonical_node.axiom: The more science explains, the clearer the portrait of God becomes, because God is written into the completions, not the gaps.
definitions: God-of-the-gaps: The argument that God is inferred from what science cannot yet explain.
God-in-the-completions: The argument that God is inferred from what science has fully explained, when read together.
Coherence Compounding: The principle that paradigm-level knowledge is multiplicative, not additive.
Kolmogorov complexity: The minimum program that generates a given output.
Bridge claim: A claim that maps a physical law to a spiritual principle, graded on the Ledger.
derivation: Science has fully explained ten fundamental forces/laws.
Each law has a spiritual reading that echoes the same algebraic structure.
The only consistent difference across all ten laws is a single variable: choice (free will).
This variable is always in the same structural position and always means the same thing.
Therefore, the pattern is not a gap in knowledge but a gap in the equation, indicating a Person.
The argument is falsifiable and quantitative, unlike the old God-of-the-gaps.
The pattern gets stronger with scientific progress, not weaker.
canonical_node.action: The system should treat the ten physical laws as a coherent set of completions that, when read together, reveal a consistent structural pattern pointing to a Person, and should test this pattern against new scientific discoveries.
boundary: This does not prove God exists.
This does not rely on ignorance or gaps in science.
This does not claim that the correspondences are proven; they are bridge claims.
This does not claim that the pattern is unique or not coincidental.
This does not claim that the cosmological predictions are resolved.
test: Check if the pattern holds for any new fundamental force discovered.
Run the Euclid test in October 2026; if w(z) = -1 exactly, the chi-field claim is dead.
Run the SPARC database; if no G_eff modification is needed, the rotation curve prediction dies.
Find a closed-system model that makes identical predictions; if it exists, the open-system claim dies.
Verify the chi-squared statistic against cosmological data with specified dataset and model.

dg1_dependencies: Ten fully explained physical laws (gravity, electromagnetism, strong/weak nuclear forces, thermodynamics, information theory, relativity, quantum mechanics, mass-energy equivalence, coherence/decoherence).
Predictions P8 and associated cosmological data (DES Y6, DESI).
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a framework for interpreting scientific completions as revealing a consistent structural pattern pointing to a Person, with falsifiable predictions.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the scientific integrity of the ten laws; does not deny their completeness or experimental confirmation.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If any of the ten laws were removed or shown to be incomplete, the pattern would lose a data point and the argument would weaken; if the pattern breaks for a new force, the argument collapses.
dg5_translation_registers: Theology: grace, love, truth, sin, faith, relationship.
Mathematics: algebraic structure, functional form, variable.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Quarantine as a bridge claim; do not treat as established physics or theology.

overstatement_risks: Claims that the pattern is 'the ONLY consistent difference' without rigorous statistical testing.
Claims that the pattern gets stronger with every discovery without specifying a formal measure.
Claims that the cosmological predictions are 'favorable' but not resolved, which could be misread as confirmation.
The 'Numbers Block' includes pending items and simulations without names, which could be overinterpreted.
kill_conditions: Euclid test: if w(z) = -1 exactly, the chi-field claim is dead.
SPARC database: if no G_eff modification is needed, the rotation curve prediction dies.
A closed-system model that makes identical predictions would kill the open-system claim.
If a new fundamental force is discovered that does not fit the pattern, the argument weakens.
risk.lean_target: The document should be treated as a theological hypothesis with testable predictions, not as a proof. The lean target is to formalize the structural correspondences and test them against data.

plain_summary: This document argues that God is not found in the gaps of scientific knowledge but in the completions - the fully explained laws of physics. It claims that ten fundamental forces, when read together, reveal a consistent structural pattern with a single variable (free will) that points to a Person. The argument is presented as falsifiable and quantitative, with specific kill conditions. However, the correspondences are declared as bridge claims, not proven, and the document itself acknowledges it could be wrong. The overall grade is C, reflecting a coherent but unproven theological interpretation.
